caption: The video showcases a sandy outdoor area enclosed by a metal fence, where a black rope marks out a looping driving course. Static props include an orange ball, a green ball, a small brown block, a red fin-shaped object half-buried in the sand, and a checkered flag marker. A small orange RC car sits at the central junction amid scattered red debris, stationary at the start before pulling away. A lower-right inset shows a man in a green cap and sunglasses holding a black controller. The car drives from the junction down into the lower triangular loop. It then travels along the bottom rope segment, kicking up sand near its wheels. The camera zooms in and tilts downward, pushing the top fence, balls and checkered marker out of frame as a dark railing enters the bottom. A cyan object and a purple ball appear in the left loop with brief dust puffs. In the inset, the man's wide open mouth later closes as he looks down toward the controller. His grip stays roughly the same throughout.
